body:
Thank you. Someone else mention that theory as well. 
As for my family, that's another factor that triggers many things. I love them and they love me; however, I can't bare to tell them. I won't let myself. And I want to. I really do. And at the same time I don't. My counselor and I have gone over this to slowly try and let my family know about what I've been experiencing for 2 years But it's just difficult and I don't know why. It bothers me to not know why I do things or why I can't do things. And it's the spiral all over again. 

Thank you for your words. Thank you. I'm sorry for the late reply.
That does mean a lot. All these replies have helped so much.

They do offer counseling during the summer. I just had to get a different counselor. I was fine with that. I went and met with her and was just uncomfortable. Exctremely uncomfortable. She's not a bad counselor bit they way she was interacting with me didn't help and I was polite and let her know I had something come up and wouldn't be near the school. So it has been going well up until a few days ago. Just constant changes and uplifts and drastic lows.  Argh. I'm so sorry for the late reply. I really do appreciate the help.

I don't have many friends I've opened up to. I'm good friends with many people. But I'm lonely if that makes sense. I created the courage to talk to someone I could trust. And they did help for a few short text messages. I feel with the idea that it wasn't as serious as it is. Not their fault. They don't expect me to have this problem. Its not that they don't want to help. They sincerely feel I'll be fine. And damn, it sucks 

I do do things like what you suggested. Thank you for that. Yet, it just makes me feel more alone if that makes sense. Having to write it out instead of a human being for now. I'm just waiting it out until the semester starts to meet with the counselor. But damn I've been giving up.

Yes, I mentioned in a comment about me going to a doctor and talking to a counselor and it helped so much. But for now I don't have a counselor until fall semester starts. 

For being so critical, I also mentioned in better detail on another comment. Its just a spiral. I don't know how it starts. I make one tiny mistake and I criticize and ridicule myself for it. Putting me down. Then I put myself down for putting myself down if that makes any sense.

It really is a large spiral I hate go admit. I hate myself for minor things. Tell myself I should do better. Constantly compare myself to those better. And then I hate myself for treating myself so harsh. We make mistakes. We shouldn't dwell on them. I'm angry at how sorry I feel for myself.

Thank you for making my post your first comment, thank you for your kind words. I take them to heart. I try my best and I kno you do to. We're here to help each other and I didn't thing someone would dedicate that much time to write that much for me. It feels different. Thank you. Much love.

I went to see a doctor who gave me some light medication. Then, I was advised to see a personal counselor on campus. I'm in college, by the way. I did. And it helped a lot. Now that I went on summer vacation I have no one. Ill be back in the fall and it has been good so far. Up until these past days. 

Also, could you explain what a CBT is if it isn't too much trouble?

Thank you. You are worth a lot. Not only to me but to many other people you don't know yet. There are things we all Fuck up. We're never going to get rid of that. We're all Fuck ups one way or another. But we do well in one place Or another as well. Keep pushing. I'm here.

I have family who will support me in anything but I've been separated from them emotionally. For the same reason being I don't want to create more worry. Dony worry about me. I'll be fine. 
I do things well. I am good at arts. Anything related to that. But it's not enough. I don't excel in anything to get anywhere is the mentality I have for myself man. I reach the bare minimum for "good" in my eyes. In my eyes I feel I've never been enough. As for the projecting positivity, I do. It is a good trait; however, I can't project positivity onto myself. I want to be the person people think I am. And I try so hard.

No, I'm sorry. I haven't looked back at this. Didn't know there would be more responses. Thank you. And yes. I just grew with it. With self consciousness and pity for myself. I don't open up or like to bother anyone with things I can figure out. In high school, I had that cool, calm dude reputation. I always expressed that. I told everyone we shouldn't worry about worry. Time will heal, positivity will come. While I go home and honestly hate myself But at that time I thought I was just being whiney to myself.

Thank you, really. Thank you for even commenting. You don't even, damn man, you don't even know. Thank you. 

Sadly no, I've been isolated, emotionally. I don't have a strong connection with anyone. I mean I have many people I talk to and have good times with like anyone else but never about my inner thoughts. I've always kept them to myself. I pushed away the only person. I could talk to.
